card.name: Missing 'that/which' before a relative clause
card.fires_on: A small word or space right after a noun where 'that' or 'which' has been left out, so a modifier or clause follows directly (e.g. 'a sinkhole 30 feet deep', 'advice a mother imparts'). Found in general web prose.

modes.label: Reduced relative clause
modes.description: A noun is followed directly by a clause with no 'that' or 'which'.
